INSERT INTO fee_param_updates (pool_address, ts, slot, signature, field, old_value, new_value)
        SELECT * FROM UNNEST(
            $1::text[], $2::timestamptz[], $3::bigint[], $4::text[], $5::text[],
            $6::bigint[], $7::bigint[]
        )
        ON CONFLICT (pool_address, ts, signature, field) DO NOTHING
